query:
SELECT
            m.id,
            m.text_channel_id,
            m.body,
            m.created_at,
            m.updated_at,
            to_jsonb(a) AS "author: Json<User>"
        FROM messages m
        LEFT JOIN users a ON a.name = m.author_name AND a.host = m.author_host
        JOIN server_channels c ON c.text_channel_id = m.text_channel_id
        WHERE c.server_id = $1
        ORDER BY m.created_at DESC;
